# v1.0.8

## Changed

- **Character indicator settings moved to the Thumbnail tab** (from General): "Show current character indicator", "Lock indicator position", and "Make indicator clickable".

## Added

- **Shift-click a square in the character indicator to toggle that client's cycle-group exclusion**, the same as shift-clicking its thumbnail. Works regardless of the "Make indicator clickable" setting.
- Cycle-excluded clients now stay in the indicator as a dim grey square (previously they disappeared), so they can be toggled back in.
